name: Black Shuck
description: Black Shuck is a spectral black dog from East Anglian folklore, associated with the coastlines and country roads of Norfolk, Suffolk, and neighboring counties, traditionally regarded as a death omen whose sighting presages death within a year.

origin: Black Shuck is associated primarily with the East Anglian counties of Norfolk, Suffolk, Cambridgeshire, and Essex. Related black dog traditions exist across the British Isles, and the phenomenon has been documented from the Highlands to the West Country, but Black Shuck is specifically the East Anglian form.
